description: ARM Green Industries Limited, formerly Calcorp Limited, was incorporated in Pakistan on 1 April 1992 as a public limited company and is quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It operates as a general-purpose holding company with investments in securities, intellectual property and other assets, and its earlier principal line of business was vehicles plied for hire. At an extraordinary general meeting on 22 January 2026 shareholders approved a change of objects to the manufacturing, assembly, trading, import and export of renewable energy equipment and ancillary products and the rendering of services.
